# negative_fixture_generation

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Generates a falsifying fixture from a preserved failure and binds the expected refusal.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fixture_id` | `string` | yes | Stable generated fixture identity. |
| `source_failure_id` | `string` | yes | Preserved failure used as source. |
| `invariant_id` | `string` | yes | Invariant challenged by the fixture. |
| `generated_input_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of deterministic negative input. |
| `expected_refusal_code` | `string` | yes | Exact refusal required for success. |
